verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a `/models/apply` API endpoint (also used by PRELOAD_MODELS), installing models from the built-in gallery via the web UI, and model aliasing. Together these imply models can be added to a running server, but the pack never explicitly states that multiple models stay loaded or that you can switch between them per request without a restart. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-model concurrent loading, per-request model switching, explicit no-restart hot-load/unload behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
